meta.name: chrome
meta.description: Claude in Chrome - browser automation via the official Anthropic extension. Control your logged-in Chrome browser, automate workflows, fill forms, extract data, and run scheduled tasks.

copy.tagline: 控制 Chrome 自动完成填表、抓数据与定时任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常需要重复操作网页,比如手动填表或批量提取数据。
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome to automate form filling, data extraction, and scheduled tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser actions like filling forms or scraping data.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过官方扩展或 DevTools MCP 控制你已登录的 Chrome：打开网页、点击元素、填写表单、提取数据、录制 GIF、定时运行任务，并在新标签页中操作，不会抢占你当前页面。
howto.when: 当你在终端用 `claude --chrome` 启动 Claude Code 并安装扩展，或配置好 Chrome DevTools MCP 后，Claude 就能控制你的 Chrome 浏览器执行操作。

say.text: 打开 github.com/anthropics 并点击 “Code” 标签页。
say.note: Claude 会在新标签页中完成导航和点击。

say.text: 打开 localhost:3000，用无效数据提交登录表单，检查错误提示。
say.note: Claude 会填写并提交表单，再检查页面反馈。

say.text: 去产品列表页，提取每个商品的名称、价格和库存，存为 CSV。
say.note: Claude 会抓取页面数据并生成 CSV 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can drive your logged-in Chrome via the official extension or DevTools MCP: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, extract data, record GIFs, and run scheduled tasks—in new tabs, not your current ones.
howto.when_en: When you start Claude Code with `claude --chrome` (extension installed) or set up the Chrome DevTools MCP, Claude can control your Chrome browser.

say_en.text: Open github.com/anthropics and click the Code tab.
say_en.note: Claude navigates and clicks in a new tab.

say_en.text: Open localhost:3000, submit the login form with invalid data, check errors.
say_en.note: Claude fills the form and checks the result.

say_en.text: Extract name, price, stock for each product on the listing page, save as CSV.
say_en.note: Claude scrapes the page and writes a CSV file.
